name: JavDB v3
deviceFindingsFromTest4: Tag taxonomy was wrong because month and duration were presented inside the generic Tag selector.
Movie ranking cards should be two columns per row; actor ranking and actor pages should be three columns per row.
Home search must open a dedicated Search page before typing/searching.
Search history must be manageable and deletable.
Independent simple=true pages and native selector/menu interactions should be used more often for low-frequency actions.
UI simplification must not remove original JavDB site functions or data access.

changes.filters: Month and duration are independent filter rows. The Tag row contains only real semantic tag groups. A second tag-value row shows the complete values for the selected tag group; no tag slicing/truncation is applied.
changes.ranking: Movie rankings use movie_2; actor monthly ranking uses movie_3 and is restored as a first-class ranking tab.
changes.search: Home uses a clickable faux search bar that opens javdb3SearchHub. SearchHub contains the real input, recent searches, per-record deletion/clear-all through native select:// management, plus actor/series/maker/director lookup entries.
changes.dataCompleteness: More restores visible access to JavDB news, series, makers, directors, account center, want-to-watch, watched, account favorites, lists and recent browsing, alongside the existing magnet/subtitle/cloud tools.
changes.nativeUi: All major task pages remain independent simple=true pages so the system title bar and native page menu behavior remain available.
